title: Bill of Rights, Amendment II: the right to keep and bear arms, in a sentence that also states a militia purpose
summary: The National Archives transcription of Amendment II, ratified 15 December 1791, is the text this card reports.
body: The National Archives transcription of the Bill of Rights gives Amendment II, ratified on 15 December 1791. The following is a close rendering in modern spelling, not a character-for-character copy of the enrolled capitalisation: A well regulated militia, being necessary to the security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed. The Archives page keeps the capitalisation of the enrolled resolution. This card reports the operative rule. It does not collect later cases that have read the sentence.

sources.title: The Bill of Rights: A Transcription
sources.author: U.S. National Archives
sources.note: Transcription opened 2026-11-18. The card quotes the transcript. It does not add a later political reading unless a second opened page says it.

said_by: United States Congress and the ratifying states
